name: comp-321
blurb: Modal to collect email addresses for newsletter subscriptions.
description: A shadcn Dialog containing an email input with a mail icon, subscribe button, and privacy policy notice.
use_when: Converting website visitors into newsletter subscribers or email list signups.
avoid_when: When users have already opted in — repeated prompts damage trust.
a11y: Email input has aria-label; mail icon is aria-hidden; inherits keyboard navigation from shadcn Dialog.
